properties.description:
SQL Server watermark control table — tracks last_loaded_at per source table.
                   Used by PL_02_JDBC_Incremental to know what to load next.

                   Table DDL (run once on SQL Server):
                   CREATE TABLE dbo.adf_watermark_control (
                       source_schema   VARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL,
                       source_table    VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
                       watermark_col   VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
                       last_loaded_at  DATETIME2    NOT NULL DEFAULT '2020-01-01',
                       last_run_at     DATETIME2,
                       rows_loaded     BIGINT       DEFAULT 0,
                       CONSTRAINT PK_watermark PRIMARY KEY (source_schema, source_table)
                   );
